data.name: Neo Kinetic
data.detailed_description:
Neo Kinetic is a fast-paced anti-gravity racer inspired by classics like Wipeout and F-Zero. Race across the world on over-the-top tracks, tearing through futuristic cities and megastructures at supersonic speeds. Take part in a new era of racing hosted by the Neo Racing League at the dawn of the 24th century, featuring ships that far exceed what was once thought technologically possible.

Features

  • Each ship offers its own playstyle

    Choose from a roster of teams with distinct backgrounds and engineering philosophies, each offering their own ships with varying strengths and weaknesses.

  • Speed classes allow for players of all skill levels

    Choose between three speed classes with significant jumps between each. Start below the sound barrier at your slowest and push far beyond it at your fastest.

  • Tracks which test you limits

    Race across a global lineup of tracks set in futuristic environments. Courses vary in difficulty, from straightforward layouts to complex designs filled with magnetic locking track sections that twist, turn, and loop in gravity-defying ways.

  • Campaign

    Take part in a globe-trotting campaign as you race in the Neo Racing League, competing in races and challenges to climb your way to the top of the standings.

  • Custom Races

    Select a track and race against opponents with combat mechanics or optionally turn of combat if you want a cleaner experience. Time trials allow you to improve you skills on specific tracks without having to worry about lap counts.
